description.en: Browse, search, edit and delete what your agents remember on every machine and project. Every edit shows a diff before it is saved.
description.ja: すべてのマシンとプロジェクトで、エージェントが覚えていることを閲覧、検索、編集、削除します。編集は保存前に差分を表示します。

scopes.machine:read: List this Mac, your cmux servers and the team VM.
scopes.memory:read: List and search agent memory files in your home folder and your workspace folders. Only memory files, never other files.
scopes.document:read: Read the memory file you open.

optionalScopes.document:write: Save an edit to a memory file after you review its diff and tap Save.
optionalScopes.fs:write: Move a memory file to the Trash when you tap Move to Trash after reviewing it.

handles.root: Your home folder's agent memory and your workspace folders, as the memory roots cmux gives this app.
handles.diff: An edit you review in the Diffs app.

title.ja: エージェントメモリのデザイン
